scenes.hook: H T M L Input Types. Let’s make it simple.
scenes.idea: Input types tell a browser what kind of value to collect. Start by understanding the role it plays in a page.
scenes.code: Email, password, and number types offer different input behavior. Read the example from top to bottom.
scenes.result: Here’s an illustration of the result. Compare it with the example you just saw. Small changes in code can change the output.
scenes.tip: An email field can participate in browser validation. Keep this detail in mind when writing your own example.
scenes.caution: Masking a password field does not encrypt or securely store its value. Understanding this helps you avoid a common beginner mistake.
scenes.try: Try three input types and compare their behavior. Change one part, then compare your result.
scenes.close: Like, share, and subscribe for more web development basics.
